'''Whitney''' is a female professor NPC lecturing a student from Department of Exostrider Engineering, '''Bram'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Whitney:''' Just look at this code you wrote. Are you on mushrooms? It's all over the place!
:'''Whitney:''' How could you put high-temperature drying and granulation in the same process?
:'''Bram:''' B-but...
:'''Whitney:''' But what?!
:'''Bram:''' In theory, this is the cheapest and most efficient solution!
:'''Whitney:''' You know what's efficient for me? You staying in your dorm and skipping my lectures. Are you purposefully trying to fail?
:'''Whitney:''' Use your head for one second. An airtight culture chamber, superheated, filled with combustible dust, plus potential sparks from the harvesters on startup...
:'''Whitney:''' One big recipe for disaster. You could blow up the Agronomy Wing ten times over.
{{Dialogue End}}
